back: The demand quantile at the critical ratio cu / (cu + co).
The loss per unit when you are short: lost margin, price minus cost.
The loss per unit left over: cost minus salvage value.
Forecast value added: (naive error − your error) / naive error. It checks if a process step helps.

front: How does pinball loss link to newsvendor?
back: Pinball loss at level tau = cu / (cu + co) equals the scaled newsvendor cost. Its minimiser is the order quantity.

front: Which horizon to forecast for ordering?
back: Lead time plus review period: the whole time you cannot change the order.
